title: Netflix announces start of production for High Tides: The Film
summary: Shooting for High Tides: The Film started today, with filming taking place in Belgium, France and Thailand.
body_markdown:
Shooting for


High Tides: The Film


started today, with filming taking place in Belgium, France and Thailand. The film is the sequel to the popular series


High Tides


, whose three seasons together spent over 24 weeks in the Dutch


[Netflix Top10](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/top10/netherlands/tv) . The beloved cast returns, including Pommelien Thijs, Willem De Schryver, Nola Elvis Kemper, Ayana Doucouré, Kes Bakker, Jef Hellemans and Daan Schuurmans.


High Tides: The Film


is expected to be released worldwide on Netflix in 2027 and promises to be full of drama and intrigue.


About


High Tides: The Film


After a long journey around the world and a search for herself, Louise returns to Knokke, but her return soon disrupts the fragile balance her friends have carefully built without her.


Knokke Off: The film is a production by Dingie for Netflix, in collaboration with Dutch FilmWorks and with support from VRT.
